tips.text: Bring a fast frame to Naamah; the Raptors are easy and run time is the real cost.
Take Circuit tiers if Nova is already offered, but never wait a week for her; running Raptors finishes sooner.
Keep running Naamah for Systems; the old boss farm has no pity system, so duplicates of the other parts are normal.
Stand on the conveyor grid, look down and press weapon-switch; walking over it drops nothing, and the cell's 10-second fuse is short.
Kill the Raptor while it is still emerging from the pipe so its Power Cell spawns inside the conveyor and skips the carry.
Skip Naamah while a Kuva Siphon overlay is on the node; one player got no Nova part from that run.
Start each component as soon as it drops so the 12-hour timers overlap.
Expect one to two hours: 15 to 25 runs of two to four minutes each.
Nobody lists Nova among the bad frame farms; the only complaint is the missing pity system.
